tts.styleInstruction: הקרא את הטקסט בעברית ישראלית טבעית וברורה, בקצב נינוח, עם הפסקות מתאימות בין משפטים ופסקאות. הקרא את הטקסט במלואו, בלי לסכם, להוסיף פתיח או להקריא את הוראות הסגנון.

elevenlabs.note: ElevenLabs. voice = the Hebrew voice id already used by the browser extension ("Oren"). eleven_v3 supports Hebrew; v3 accepts 5,000 characters per request, chunkMaxChars is 1,800. eleven_multilingual_v2 does NOT list Hebrew. Gemini stays available: set provider to gemini-api, model to gemini-2.5-flash-preview-tts, voice to Charon, language to null.

gemini-3.6-flash.note: assumed same as gemini-2.5-flash; not confirmed against the pricing page

eleven_v3.note: ESTIMATE. ElevenLabs bills credits (1 per character on eleven_v3), and the dollar price depends on the subscription plan: 0.22 USD per 1,000 characters is about the Creator plan (22 USD for 100,000 credits). On a monthly plan the credits are already paid for, so the real limit is the credit balance (bin/verify-access.mjs prints it); this ledger only guards against runaway spending. If a run stops with 'spend limit reached', raise limits.spendLimitUsd.

eleven_v4.note: ESTIMATE, same as eleven_v3; v4 credit cost per character is not documented on the models page.

storage.note: Set backend to wix-media to store the files in the site Media Manager instead.
